flipToBack.prose: Flip when there are 4 or more cards stacked beneath Credits Will Do Fine (which must be active on table).

children.req: card-on-table: Credits Will Do Fine active
count/counter: at least 4 cards stacked beneath Credits Will Do Fine
children.filter: stacked cards on the found Credits Will Do Fine card

flipToFront.prose: Back (We'll Need A New One (V)) has NO flip-to-front trigger and NO place-out-of-play condition; getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers contains no FlipCardEffect or PlaceCardOutOfPlayFromTableEffect. Once flipped, it stays flipped.

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is a pure COUNTER condition: >= 4 cards stacked beneath the Credits Will Do Fine effect; no control/occupy/presence board requirement at all.
Credits Will Do Fine must be ACTIVE on table (Filters.findFirstActive); if it leaves table the flip can never trigger.
No flip-back and no hard-lose: the back is permanent.
Front remainder-of-game locks are applied as until-end-of-game modifiers at deployment completion, so they persist after flip (Card210_025.java:78-95).
typedIdentities: Filters.Credits_Will_Do_Fine (gate card; stacking driven by that card's own game text)
Deploy lock exceptions: Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.unique, Filters.alien), Filters.Republic_character, Filters.Republic_starship, Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.Jedi))
Filters.Your_Destiny (suspended); Filters.and(Filters.Objective, Icon.REFLECTIONS_II) (no Force loss from)
Filters.and(Filters.Maul, Filters.not(Filters.with(self, Filters.QuiGon))) (Maul immune to attrition unless present with Qui-Gon)
Back: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.unique, Filters.Republic_character); Filters.Queens_Royal_Starship; Filters.or(Filters.Jar_Jar, Filters.Amidala); Filters.Tatooine_location
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Watto's Junkyard, City Outskirts, and Credits Will Do Fine from Reserve Deck (Card210_025.java:51-75).
Front once per game (THE_HYPERDRIVE_GENERATORS_GONE__UPLOAD_EPISODE_I_SYSTEM): take an [Episode I] system into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Card210_025.java:98-117).
No downloads on the back; back economy = retrieval on battle destiny draws and QRS Force activation.
otherObligations: Front remainder-of-game deploy lock: no cards with ability except unique aliens, Republic characters, [Republic] starships, [Episode I] Jedi; also no dejarik-rules ability deploys (Card210_025.java:82-87).
Front: Your Destiny suspended (:88-90); you lose no Force from [Reflections II] objectives (:91-93).
Front liability: Maul is immune to attrition unless present with Qui-Gon (Card210_025.java:120-125).
Back: your unique Republic characters power +1 forfeit +2 (Card210_025_BACK.java:59-60); aliens' deploy cost may not be modified to Tatooine locations (:61).
Back: on completing a non-substituted battle destiny draw, may retrieve 1 Force, may take into hand (Card210_025_BACK.java:66-93).
Back: once during opponent's turn, if Queen's Royal Starship at a system, activate up to 2 Force (Card210_025_BACK.java:101-128).

Back Force-loss engine: during your control phase opponent loses 1 Force per battleground occupied by Amidala or Jar Jar; auto-fires at end of control phase if unused (Card210_025_BACK.java:130-158, helper :161-180).
Strategic pre-flip: stack cards on Credits Will Do Fine as fast as possible; protect Credits Will Do Fine (flip is impossible without it active).
